zin_gunwaith_heal_the_ford = {
	Y08 = {
		remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_grey_ford_truce }
		remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_west_ford_blood }
		reverse_remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_grey_ford_truce }
		reverse_remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_west_ford_blood }
	}
	add_opinion_modifier = {
		target = Y08
		modifier = zin_gunwaith_ford_brothers
	}
	reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
		target = Y08
		modifier = zin_gunwaith_ford_brothers
	}
}

zin_gunwaith_claim_lesser_crowns = {
	every_neighbor_country = {
		limit = {
			capital_scope = { zin_is_region_west_lands = yes }
			num_of_controlled_states < 5
			NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
		}
		every_owned_state = { add_claim_by = ROOT }
	}
}

zin_gunwaith_wargoal_lesser_crown = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_gunwaith_claim_best = 0 }
	every_neighbor_country = {
		limit = {
			capital_scope = { zin_is_region_west_lands = yes }
			num_of_controlled_states < 5
			NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_gunwaith_claim_size = num_of_controlled_states }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_gunwaith_claim_size > global.zin_gunwaith_claim_best } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_gunwaith_claim_best = zin_gunwaith_claim_size }
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_gunwaith_claim_target
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gunwaith_claim_best > 0 } }
		create_wargoal = {
			type = puppet_wargoal_focus
			target = event_target:zin_gunwaith_claim_target
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_character (keyword zin_gunwaith_ostra 1).
zin_gunwaith_recruit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 1 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_gunwaith_ostra }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_gunwaith_ostra
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_gunwaith_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_gunwaith_ford_brothers
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_gunwaith_ford_brothers
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 2 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_gunwaith_opinion_equals
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_gunwaith_opinion_equals
			}
		}
	}
}
